scientific_integrity: Constructive all-order proofs accompany exact formulae. Finite verification checks are independent corroboration, not a substitute for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns labeled rook graphs K_n box K_m, n>=m>=3, minimum total dominating sets, and unrestricted one-selected-square replacements; this is not a statement about all minimal sets, token slides, or other product graphs. Novelty is assessed from accessible primary literature and records, so unindexed equivalent reconfiguration results remain possible.
title: Frozen supports and Desargues islands in optimum total-domination exchanges of rook graphs
